mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a risk premium adjustment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during inflation spikes above 0.3%, or the S&P 500 declines despite CPIAUCSL > 0.3.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% is associated with increased wage growth expectations, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% from the prior month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat despite PAYEMS > prior month +0.5%, or wage growth is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly increase in HOUST industrial production exceeding 2% signals strengthening supply-side demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by more than 2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when HOUST shows such double-digit growth, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO supply index below 95 triggers a supply-side contraction that predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 95 for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during INDPRO < 95, or the decline is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4%, the increased discount rate reduces expected equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the current month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS > 4%, or the effect is not robust across multiple such episodes (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4% indicates labor market slack, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during UNRATE < 4%, or the signal is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) exceeding 2% each suggest resilient consumer and business demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > +2% AND RSAFS > +2% in the current month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive when both proxies exceed +2%, or the interaction p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS falls by more than 5% in a month, indicating weak retail demand, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days are expected to be negative due to supply-side imbalance.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases by >5% from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during RSAFS monthly decline >5%, or the effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
